plaatsen.tekst: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
